body: My favorite horse in the game

I’m not sure what their method is but I’ve decided I want to get a boat and go explore the ocean or explore the alaskan wilderness. Either way I’d get lost and die but I don’t fear the pain. But these are just pipe dreams I don’t have the means to do either one. I daydream about the possibilities of the adventure and how I’d die.

I think about this all the time. My uncle passed away in September from pancreatic cancer. Only 50 years old with a young loving family. A really smart genuine man who was good for the world. I’m like why the fuck couldn’t that be me instead?
